title: Brazen Boston Home Depot thief who said he’d be back to steal more items gets jail time
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Crime "He presents a clear threat to our retail community and this prison sentence is entirely justified by his repeated offenses," Suffolk District Attorney Kevin Hayden said.
A Boston man was sentenced Tuesday in Suffolk Superior Court for a series of thefts from Home Depot stores in the South Bay Mall and West Roxbury.
Jeramie Croft, 42, who has a lengthy history of shoplifting and trespassing, was sentenced to up to three years in state prison, Suffolk District Attorney Kevin Hayden said in a release.

title: Bourne emergency personnel transported a trapped raccoon, complete with sewer grate, to Cape Wildlife Center
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Local News “In our line of work it sometimes takes a village to do what we do and this young raccoon had so many people fighting to save him today,” the center said.
Cape Wildlife Center First responders in Bourne came together to rescue a raccoon whose head was wedged through the grate of a storm drain, transporting him to Cape Wildlife Center.

The responders collaborated to get the entire sewer grate and raccoon transported as one to the center, as the center’s veterinary staff were actively dealing with other emergencies and were unable to sedate the raccoon on scene, the center said in a social media post.
